title: fieldwork::media_processing — image resize, crop, EXIF strip, filters
description: Pure-logic image processing module in fieldwork (not fieldwork-db). Resize to standard sizes, strip EXIF, generate thumbnails, apply color filters. Uses the image crate. No DB dependency — takes bytes in, returns processed bytes out. All three servers use this.
close_reason: fieldwork::media_processing module created with 10 tests. Smallhold+gaja wired, ~200 lines of duplicated code eliminated.
